description: This file defines a registry and utility functions for managing MIME type marshalers used in gRPC Gateway runtime, including functions for selecting appropriate marshalers based on HTTP headers and configuring the registry.

methods.name: MarshalerForRequest
methods.description: Determines inbound and outbound marshalers based on HTTP request headers, matching MIME types in the registry.

methods.name: makeMarshalerMIMERegistry
methods.description: Creates and returns a new registry mapping MIME types to marshalers, with a default wildcard entry.

methods.name: WithMarshalerOption
methods.description: Returns a server mux option to associate a specific MIME type with a marshaler.
